title: EvaLooop: A Self-Consistency-centered Framework for Assessing Large Language Model Robustness in Programming

bias_targets.methodology: Applying multiple distinct adversarial attack strategies (Case Transformation, Structural Reformatting, Redundant Elaboration) to LLMs and demonstrating how different attack methods yield contradictory robustness rankings that inconsistently favor specific models.

Conducting a human audit of 100 loop transitions evaluated by an LLM judge (GPT-4-turbo) to detect whether the AI evaluator exhibited any systematic scoring preferences for specific model architectures.
